definitions.explanation: Having a pleasantly warm temperature, typically referring to climate.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{一年|いちねん}{中|じゅう}{温暖|おんだん}だ。
examples.english: This region is warm all year round.

examples.japanese: {温暖|おんだん}な{気候|きこう}で{過|す}ごしやすい。
examples.english: The warm climate makes it easy to live here.

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}が{進|すす}んでいる。

notes:
{温暖|おんだん} describes warm climate or temperature, especially for regions.

FORMS:
- {温暖|おんだん}な + noun (warm ~)
- {温暖|おんだん}に (warmly)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {温暖|おんだん}な{気候|きこう} (warm climate)
- {温暖|おんだん}な{地域|ちいき} (warm region)

IMPORTANT COMPOUND:
- {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か} (global warming)
- {温暖|おんだん}{化|か}{対策|たいさく} (measures against warming)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {暖|あたた}かい: warm (general, casual)
- {温暖|おんだん}: warm climate (more technical/formal)
- {穏|おだ}やか: mild, gentle (personality/weather)
